combat-control.config.title: Combat Control Config
combat-control.config.desc.player.modern: Will play modern combat hit sounds. If disabled, it just plays the classic hit sound
Whether modern pvp particles such as damage indicators are displayed
combat-control.config.desc.player.sweepA: Whether sweep attacks are enabled. Even if disabled, the sweeping edge enchantment will still perform a sweep attack
combat-control.config.desc.player.modern: Enables fast regeneration as seen in modern Minecraft. If disabled, health regenerates every 4 seconds with at least 18 food. Full saturation also no longer regenerates health quickly.
Modern notch apple gives regeneration 2 and absorption 4. Disabling this gives regeneration 5 and absorption 1 instead, as it used to
combat-control.config.desc.player.noWeak: If enabled, prevents knockback from attacks with zero damage (e.g. snowball hit)
combat-control.config.desc.player.noFish: If enabled, fishing rod hits will not apply knockback
combat-control.config.desc.player.strong: Whether players attacked in the air will take more knockback
combat-control.config.desc.player.noSpri: If enabled, critical hits will not be possible while sprinting
combat-control.config.desc.player.noAtta: If enabled, attacking will stop sprinting
combat-control.config.desc.player.fishin: If enabled, fishing rod pulls will apply a slight upwards boost
combat-control.config.desc.player.modern: If enabled, hooking an entity will cause 5 damage to a fishing rod. Otherwise, only 3 damage are applied to the rod.
combat-control.config.desc.player.attack: Whether attack is allowed while using an item (e.g. aiming a bow or eating food) used to be possible in 1.7.10 and before
combat-control.config.title.player.rende: Render arm swing while using items
combat-control.config.desc.player.render: Whether the arm swing animation should render properly while using an item, should definitely be enabled when attackWhileUsing is enabled
combat-control.config.desc.player.modern: If enabled, attacking will damage the held item by 2, otherwise only by 1
If enabled, the sharpness enchantment adds 0.5 damage per level. If disabled, it is 1.25 damage per level
combat-control.config.desc.player.noReeq: Skip equip animation when using items (e.g. shield)
combat-control.config.desc.player.slowFi: If enabled, the fishing rod will move slower, as seen in 1.9+ versions
combat-control.config.desc.player.modern: If enabled, plays the modern fishing rod reeling sounds
combat-control.config.desc.player.fishin: Whether reeling in an entity pulls it towards the player. Many PVP servers disabled this, however it was always enabled in vanilla
combat-control.config.desc.global.modern: If enabled, tools like axes will deal the modern amount of damage that takes cooldown into account. If disabled, damage values will be reverted / adapted to 1.8 and previous versions
combat-control.config.desc.global.larger: Expand hitboxes by 10% to make hits more accurate
combat-control.config.desc.client.instan: Disables the smooth sneak animation, like in older versions. Note: In newer versions, the sneak-height is lower. That is why the movement is more extreme.
combat-control.config.desc.client.oldAtt: Displays attributes like in earlier versions. Recognizable by the blue text.
combat-control.config.desc.client.oldBob: Renders the classic bobbing effect, with a slight head tilt when jumping. Will only work if view bobbing is enabled.
